team.label: La Pitaya team
team.hint: Fills name, character, description and goal with a CIMA role. You review and spawn.

locales.agentLocaleDesc: The language La Pitaya agents write their messages and reports in. Independent of the interface language. Commands, code, logs and test output are never translated.
locales.notificationLocaleDesc: The language of notices and, later, of Alicia's summaries. Independent of the interface language.

governance.title: GOVERNANCE APPROVALS
governance.approveHint: Approve allows ONE execution of this exact call. The agent must retry it.

governance_blocked.title: Blocked by CIMA
governance_blocked.message: The action was blocked by CIMA ({{rule}}). {{explanation}}

governance_supervised.title: Supervised action
governance_supervised.message: {{agent}} ran a medium-risk action under supervision. {{explanation}}

approval_granted.title: Approval granted
approval_granted.message: You approved the action from {{agent}}. It will run once.

approval_denied.title: Approval rejected
approval_denied.message: You rejected the action from {{agent}}. It will not run.

workflow_completed.title: Work accepted
workflow_completed.message: Task {{task}} has a DECISION PASS recorded by the runtime.

intent_forwarded.title: Sent to El Inge
intent_forwarded.message: Your request reached El Inge as a proposal; nothing runs until you confirm.

intent_governed.title: Action governed by CIMA
intent_governed.message: CIMA evaluated your action: risk {{risk}}, decision {{decision}}. {{explanation}}

intent_blocked.title: Request blocked
intent_blocked.message: Your request was not sent: CIMA blocked it ({{rule}}). {{explanation}}

error.title: Error
error.message: Something went wrong. See the technical detail.

explain.HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: This action needs your approval because it is classified as {{riskLabel}}.
explain.SUPERVISED: It was allowed under supervision and recorded in the ledger.
explain.APPROVED: It ran once with your approval.
explain.HUMAN_APPROVED: You approved it; that allows one run of that exact call.
explain.HUMAN_REJECTED: You rejected it; it will not run.
explain.DENY: La Pitaya could not authorize this action, so it did not run.
explain.DECISION_GATE: The task cannot be marked done without a DECISION PASS recorded by the runtime.
explain.EVIDENCE_FIRST: The result has no evidence the harness observed.
explain.BUILDER_NOT_AUDITOR: Whoever built the change cannot pass its own tests or audit.
explain.AUDITOR_MODIFIED_CODE: The auditor modified files after BUILD; an auditor never changes what it audits.
explain.TRANSITION: Earlier CIMA phases are missing, so this step cannot be accepted.
explain.DECISION_AUTHORITY: Only El Inge or the human can accept the work.
explain.MALFORMED: The CIMA report is not in the required format.
explain.ALLOW: It is low risk: allowed automatically, and authorized again when it runs.
explain.NOT_AUTHORIZED: Alicia has no authority to approve or to issue a DECISION; that belongs to you and El Inge.
explain.INTENT_INVALID: The request was incomplete or malformed, so it was not processed.
explain.INTENT_TARGET: Alicia can only address requests to El Inge, not to other agents or to tools.
explain.INTENT_MISMATCH: What you asked for carries more risk than the proposed action, so CIMA did not send it.
explain.DELIVERY_FAILED: The request could not be delivered to El Inge.
explain.BOUNDARY_UNAVAILABLE: The request boundary did not answer; nothing was done.
explain.UNKNOWN: Rule {{rule}} stopped it. See the technical detail.

evidence.verified: {{verified}}/{{total}} evidence items verified by the harness

reply.task: I'm here. Task {{task}} is at {{phase}} ({{phaseLabel}}); you have {{unread}} unread notices.
reply.idle: I'm here. There is no active task; you have {{unread}} unread notices.

intentTypes.ACTION: Action: goes through CIMA (risk, autonomy and authorization) before it runs.
